Him who mountain crush him no...
It started out as a perfect day.
One little light illuminated the cellar
There was a small crowd outside
The locker room wasn’t big enough.
In theory, the only problem in Fred’s life now was his door.

Ankh-Morpork’s Finest strolled back down toward the Yard.
“Say that again, paying attention to every word, will you?” said Vimes.

“I don’t think I can go through with this,"
“There’s something I didn’t want to mention in front of her ladyship,”

In a dank cellar that once was an attic...
Nobby Nobbs, a shadow in the warm red gloom, nudged Sergeant Colon.
Coffee was only a way of stealing time...
. . . The troll mob was a tableau.

I should be in charge of the mine raid...
The entity slithered through the rainy streets.
There was a crowd of dwarfs milling around outside the Yard.
The showers in the Watch house were the talk of the city.
Vimes sat and stared at his notebook.

Fred Colon peered through the bars.
Fun. What is it good for?
It was odd, having Sybil in Pseudopolis Yard.
“I’ve never been on a girls’ night out before,”
The Ramkins never threw anything away.
The entity known as the Summoning Dark...

You could catch up with the dwarf...

Vimes, half limping and half running...
—and went down as a werewolf landed on his back.
It hadn’t exactly been an ambush...
It would be a lot simpler...
Wandering through the world, the eternal troll . . .
Trolls and dwarfs had raised a huge roundhouse in Koom Valley...
